# FYPMate

> FYPMate (https://fypmate.com) is an academic collaboration and AI validation platform designed for university students to form high-performing Final Year Project (FYP) teams and benchmark project proposals against institutional defense standards.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI FYP Idea Validator (https://fypmate.com/idea-validator):** Evaluates student Final Year Project proposals against five dimensions: novelty & originality, technical difficulty, timeline feasibility, team skill fit, and hardware cost tier. Generates a composite feasibility score (0-100) and downloadable academic PDF reports.
- **Teammate & Partner Discovery:** Verified university student matching based on technical skills, desired industry focus, semester, and availability status.
- **Academic Milestone Tracking:** Built-in workspace for group registration, proposal drafting, and defense readiness.

## Institutional Background

- **Origin Institution:** Pak-Austria Fachhochschule: Institute of Applied Sciences and Technology (PAF-IAST).
- **Academic Supervision:** Dr. Muhammad Shuaib Qureshi (Chief Scientific Officer at Datalligence.pk).
- **Platform Developer:** Muhammad bin Mushtaq.
